selection: Eight locked never-matrix-exposed public identities selected after isolated sealed boolean scoreability admission. H63 remains failure-accounting policy. Each shared trajectory pauses after the first pinned-base read is proven delivered by a successful exact-request receipt; the confirming response is held without tool effects before control and treatment are cloned.
instrument_treatment: Validator-proven indeterminate calls debit their full admitted bound; affected pairs are symmetric zeros and later independent tasks continue.
treatment: At the first confirmed-read boundary, both arms receive the same held-action notice. Treatment alone receives one receipt-bound, gold-blind evidence guidance projection capped at eight candidates, 4,096 bytes, and 1,024 provider-measured tokens. Both then resume normal tools and reasoning under the original limits; no final slate is added.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and guidance-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
A validator-proven zero-byte indeterminate call is debited at its full admitted bound and its pair is retained as symmetric zeros.
Any unbounded usage, delivery-boundary, held-effect, ancestry, first-prompt, exposure, or token-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
